title: v1_111 / AI CLI profile group in terminal dropdown (Experimental)
content:
## AI CLI profile group in terminal dropdown (Experimental)

**Setting**: `setting(terminal.integrated.experimental.aiProfileGrouping)`

AI CLI terminal profiles, such as GitHub Copilot CLI, are now displayed in a dedicated group at the top of the terminal profile dropdown for improved discoverability. To enable this feature, turn on the `setting(terminal.integrated.experimental.aiProfileGrouping)` setting.

![Screenshot of the terminal profile dropdown showing the new AI CLI profile group.](images/1_111/ai-cli-profile-group.png)
